payload.text: ISSUE 0657 (filed by vc at 6d852eb04 on hv's "A: file the fix now"): install's HEAD check refuses only when commits past the built sha touch DIRT_SCOPE or a support path. Size S, cc's to bank when Intent's queue reaches it in the next train, after Part B's train (doing 96). Until it lands, a commit to main between a build and its install makes the fresh pair refuse, so main holds through every build all. Light work only under decision 92.
